sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_beans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NULL, "farm" TEXT NULL, "process" TEXT NULL, "flavor_tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bean_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "bean_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES coffee_beans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "roast_date" INTEGER NULL, "roast_level" TEXT NULL, "remaining_grams" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "initial_grams" REAL NULL, "price" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grinders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "burr_type" TEXT NULL, "scale_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'click', "zero_point" REAL NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "clicks_per_revolution" INTEGER NULL, "microns_per_click" REAL NULL, "calibration_note" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pourOver', "dose_grams" REAL NULL, "water_grams" REAL NULL, "ratio" REAL NULL, "water_temp" REAL NULL, "total_time_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "pour_stages" TEXT NULL, "grind_suggestion" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "bean_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES coffee_beans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "grinder_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES grinders (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "recipe_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pourOver', "method_label" TEXT NULL, "grind_setting" REAL NULL, "grind_clicks" INTEGER NULL, "grinder_zero_point_snapshot" REAL NULL, "grinder_clicks_per_revolution_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "dose_grams" REAL NULL, "water_grams" REAL NULL, "ratio" REAL NULL, "water_temp" REAL NULL, "total_time_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "dripper" TEXT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "flavor_tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "brewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_best" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_best" IN (0, 1)), "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "tds" REAL NULL, "extraction_yield" REAL NULL, "water_ppm" INTEGER NULL, "ambient_temp" REAL NULL, "ambient_humidity" REAL NULL, "bean_temp" REAL NULL, "pressure" REAL NULL, "pour_stages" TEXT NULL, "bean_roast_date" INTEGER NULL, "bean_roast_level" TEXT NULL, "heat_level" TEXT NULL, "yield_grams" REAL NULL, "preheat_upper_chamber" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("preheat_upper_chamber" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_log_beans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "brew_log_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES brew_logs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "bean_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES coffee_beans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "batch_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES bean_batches (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "bean_name_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "roast_date_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "dose_grams" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_log_addins" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "brew_log_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES brew_logs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ml', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extra_attributes" ("owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "is_builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_builtin" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_type", "owner_id", "key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_extra_owner ON extra_attributes (owner_type, owner_id)
